groups.problem: The public findMany method was removed (and the service's return contract changed to Prisma.Sql), breaking existing consumers of InsightsBookingService.
groups.rationale: Both report the same API-breaking change in which findMany was replaced by getBaseConditions without migrating callers. S5's mention of the changed return types is part of the same breaking-contract concern.

groups.problem: The getBaseConditions branches that handle falsy authConditions (returning filterConditions alone, or NOTHING_CONDITION) are wrong: unreachable, or a latent auth bypass.
groups.rationale: Both target the same falsy-auth branches in getBaseConditions. Restructuring it to always AND in the auth predicate resolves both, even though one frames the branches as dead code and the other as an authorization bypass.
